Name: Pet Rats
Author: huptiq
Description:
Elevate your Stardew Valley experience with the [b]Pet Rats[/b] mod, where each rat brings a special touch to your farm. These four adoptable rats may share the same selfmade, unique squeaky sounds, but their personalities are all their own. They’re not just cute; they’re also generous, offering gifts like [b]Cheese[/b], [b]Bone Fragments[/b], [b]Wild Berries[/b], and an intriguing [b]secret item[/b] as your friendship flourishes.

[b]Pet Rats [/b]is a global addition, with support for all player languages. Whether you’re embarking on a new game or you’re deep into your farming life, you can get your rat companion from the start or adopt one from Marnie’s Shop for 10,000 Gold.


The mod continues to grow, with more rat friends on the horizon.
And with Update 1.3.0, accessorize your rats with [b]hats[/b] using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22631]Hats On Pets Plus[/url] mod—optional, but oh-so-fashionable!
[i]([u]Hats on Pets Plus[/u] is absolutely [u]optional[/u], only download it if you want to put hats on rats)[/i]

A round of applause for the creators of [b]Pet Rats[/b]:

Sprites and Icons: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/skellady/about-me]skellady[/url]
Coding: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/rothag88/about-me]Rothag[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/huptiq/about-me]huptiq[/url]
Sounds: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/huptiq/about-me]huptiq
[/url]
Prepare for a heartwarming addition to your farm life with these adorable, squeaky companions that are sure to bring joy and surprises to your Stardew Valley adventure! 🌻🐀
